PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(CONTROL OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) (REVOCATION) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 7(1) of the

Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister revokes the

prohibition of printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of publications specified in column (1) of the

Schedule which have been published vide the Orders specified in column (2).
